reference_sql:
WITH weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT week_start FROM calendar WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'),
units AS (SELECT ol.product_id, c.week_start, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN calendar c ON c.cal_date = CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) GROUP BY ol.product_id, c.week_start)
SELECT p.product_id, w.week_start, COALESCE(u.units, 0) AS units
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN weeks w
LEFT JOIN units u ON u.product_id = p.product_id AND u.week_start = w.week_start
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'

solver.query:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT week_start
  FROM calendar
  WHERE week_start >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND week_start <= DATE '2025-03-31'
), sold AS (
  SELECT l.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS d, l.quantity
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, w.week_start, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) AS units
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN weeks w
LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.product_id = p.product_id AND s.d >= w.week_start AND s.d <= w.week_start + 6
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'
GROUP BY p.product_id, w.week_start
